verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's first-party docs describe Automations that schedule prompts to run automatically at recurring times. Each run creates a chat and executes through the normal chat completion pipeline, and automations can be paused and resumed without being deleted. This is a true recurring schedule, not a one-off action. missing for 10: documentation of schedule granularity or cron-style options, evidence that scheduled runs can chain multi-step workflows beyond a single prompt, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
